name: prism-callee
description: Run the Prism Story and Epic lifecycles as workflows of specialized Callee subagents.

interface.shortDescription: Prism workflow with specialized Callee subagents.
interface.longDescription: Runs Prism Story and Epic lifecycles as workflows composed of specialized, phase-specific Callee subagents, resolves one Beads item at a time or explicit open-Epic batches, collects current-item approval through Callee Human and Approval gates, and stops only when approval is withheld, validation completes, or another blocking condition is hit.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $prism-callee:lifecycle to run a Prism Story or Epic through specialized prism/* subagents and the explicit Callee approval gate.
